_meta.rationale: Vercel falls through to DEFAULT_FREE_ALTERNATIVE. About-team title element is .at__title. Phase 3.2 strips photo avatars. Negative trademark scan covers slug=vercel strip targets.
gaps: Geist not in registry (same gap as vercel_alphabet).

assertions.evaluate: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('.at__title'); if (!el) return false; const fam = window.getComputedStyle(el).fontFamily || ''; return fam.toLowerCase().includes('inter'); })()

(() => { const html = document.documentElement.outerHTML.toLowerCase(); const forbidden = ['vercel.com/logo', 'vercel-logo', 'vercel-triangle', '/logo.svg', '/wordmark.svg', '/brand/logo']; return forbidden.every(s => !html.includes(s)); })()
(() => { const members = document.querySelectorAll('.at__member'); if (members.length === 0) return false; for (const m of members) { if (m.querySelector('img')) return false; } return true; })()
